scope: two additional paired initialization seeds; training-only, not generalization
optimizer: fresh Adam eps1e-8, no clipping or scheduler
fixed: same 120 selected examples and order in all four cases; initial weights differ between seeds but are paired between gains within seed
primary: paired gain2-minus-gain1 final accuracy and loss at step400 for EACH new seed
decision: Directional replication only if gain2 has strictly lower final loss AND strictly higher final accuracy in BOTH new seeds. Otherwise mixed/not-replicated; preserve all runs and do not select best seeds. Even directional replication does not prove statistical significance or generalization.
historical_seed2070: exploratory result retained separately; not included as a new replication seed
failure: nonfinite loss or missing gradients stops; retain partial output without completion marker, no automatic resume or seed replacement
limits: two initializations on one fixed training subset, not independently sampled datasets
gain acts throughout training, no initialization-only attribution
no recognition accuracy on held-out or real RF data
